import json, sys

def check(obj, inp):
    assert set(obj) == {"rounds","metrics","classes","summary"}, set(obj)
    R = len(inp["rounds"]); n = inp["n"]
    assert isinstance(obj["rounds"], list) and len(obj["rounds"]) == R
    for i, r in enumerate(obj["rounds"]):
        assert set(r) == {"id","started","source_final_us","source_complete","host_delivery_us","source_proof"}, set(r)
        assert r["id"] == i and type(r["id"]) is int
        assert type(r["started"]) is bool
        if r["started"]:
            assert type(r["source_final_us"]) is int and type(r["source_complete"]) is bool
            assert r["source_final_us"] <= inp["rounds"][i]["launch_us"] + inp["rounds"][i]["timeout_us"]
            assert r["host_delivery_us"] is None or type(r["host_delivery_us"]) is int
            if r["host_delivery_us"] is not None:
                assert r["host_delivery_us"] == r["source_final_us"] + inp["rounds"][i]["host_delay_us"]
            else:
                assert inp["rounds"][i]["drop_host_ack"] is True
            assert isinstance(r["source_proof"], list)
            assert r["source_proof"] == sorted(set(r["source_proof"]))
            assert all(type(x) is int and 0 <= x < len(inp["edges"]) for x in r["source_proof"])
        else:
            assert r["source_final_us"] is None and r["source_complete"] is None and r["host_delivery_us"] is None
            assert r["source_proof"] == []
    m = obj["metrics"]
    assert set(m) == {"host_probe_tx","network_ping_tx","network_ack_tx","host_ack_tx",
                      "deduplicated_ping","capacity_drops","late_ping","ignored_ack",
                      "allocations","cache_peak","peak_entries","end_us"}, set(m)
    for k,v in m.items():
        if k == "cache_peak":
            assert isinstance(v,list) and len(v)==n and all(type(x) is int and x>=0 for x in v)
        else:
            assert type(v) is int and v >= 0, (k,v)
    assert m["host_probe_tx"] == R
    assert m["host_ack_tx"] == sum(1 for r in obj["rounds"] if r["started"])
    assert m["peak_entries"] <= sum(m["cache_peak"]) or True
    assert m["peak_entries"] >= max(m["cache_peak"]) if m["cache_peak"] else True
    labels = [e["label"] for e in inp["edges"]]
    for c in obj["classes"]:
        assert set(c) == {"signature","candidate_count","evidence_rounds","state","candidate_witnesses"}
        assert c["candidate_count"] >= 1 and type(c["candidate_count"]) is int
        assert c["state"] in ("unobserved","unique","ambiguous")
        assert c["evidence_rounds"] == sorted(set(c["evidence_rounds"]))
        if c["evidence_rounds"]:
            assert c["state"] == ("unique" if c["candidate_count"]==1 else "ambiguous")
        else:
            assert c["state"] == "unobserved"
        for w in c["candidate_witnesses"]:
            assert isinstance(w,list) and len(w)>=1
            assert all(type(x) is int and 0 <= x < len(labels) for x in w)
            # verify it is a contiguous source->dest path with the class signature
            u=0
            for x in w:
                e=inp["edges"][x]; assert e["u"]==u; u=e["v"]
            assert u==n-1
            assert [labels[x] for x in w] == c["signature"]
        if len(c["candidate_witnesses"])==2:
            assert c["candidate_witnesses"][0]!=c["candidate_witnesses"][1]
        else:
            assert c["candidate_count"]==1
    # classes sorted, and cover all full-graph paths exactly once
    sigs=[c["signature"] for c in obj["classes"]]
    assert sigs==sorted(sigs)
    assert len(set(map(tuple,sigs)))==len(sigs)
    assert sum(c["candidate_count"] for c in obj["classes"]) == obj["summary"]["topology_paths"]
    # independent path count
    n_=inp["n"]; out={}
    for i,e in enumerate(inp["edges"]): out.setdefault(e["u"],[]).append(i)
    cnt=[0]*n_; cnt[n_-1]=1
    for v in range(n_-2,-1,-1): cnt[v]=sum(cnt[inp["edges"][i]["v"]] for i in out.get(v,()))
    assert obj["summary"]["topology_paths"]==cnt[0]
    s=obj["summary"]
    assert set(s)=={"topology_paths","observable_classes","observed_classes","unique_observed_classes",
                    "ambiguous_observed_classes","path_evidence_lower","path_evidence_upper","coverage_status"}
    assert s["observable_classes"]==len(obj["classes"])
    assert s["observed_classes"]==sum(1 for c in obj["classes"] if c["evidence_rounds"])
    assert s["unique_observed_classes"]==sum(1 for c in obj["classes"] if c["evidence_rounds"] and c["candidate_count"]==1)
    assert s["ambiguous_observed_classes"]==sum(1 for c in obj["classes"] if c["evidence_rounds"] and c["candidate_count"]>1)
    assert s["path_evidence_lower"]==s["observed_classes"]
    assert s["path_evidence_upper"]==sum(c["candidate_count"] for c in obj["classes"] if c["evidence_rounds"])
    exp = ("no-routes" if s["observable_classes"]==0 else "no-evidence" if s["observed_classes"]==0
           else "complete" if s["observed_classes"]==s["observable_classes"] else "partial")
    assert s["coverage_status"]==exp, (s["coverage_status"],exp)
    return True

if __name__=="__main__":
    out=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); inp=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
    check(out,inp); print("schema OK")
